latest_news.title: Syria-Russia deal reorganizes Tartous and Hmeimim bases
latest_news.summary: AP and Reuters report Syria will assume civil control of Hmeimim airport and Tartous's commercial berth while the military facilities transition into joint training centers. Russia had not immediately commented. Strategic posture change only; no canonical signal or probability change.

latest_news.title: Türkiye clarifies scope of Makkah defence pact
latest_news.summary: AP reports help requires a formal request and could range from intelligence or logistics to military-unit deployment. Türkiye says the pact targets no third country and preserves existing alliances; Egypt may join later. No nuclear-sharing evidence or canonical signal change.

latest_news.title: Israel rejects U.S. 15-point Gaza plan
latest_news.summary: Reuters and AP report Prime Minister Netanyahu rejected the Board of Peace plan and ruled out an IDF withdrawal until Hamas is fully disarmed. Hamas says it remains committed to the roadmap. Canonical israel_palestine:diplomacy_refused activated; probability 98→99.

latest_news.title: Houthi attack kills seven at Yemen's Mokha port
latest_news.summary: AP reports Houthi missiles, drones and an explosive boat killed at least seven, injured 15 civilians and damaged port infrastructure and supplies. Existing ceasefire_violation and infrastructure_strike signals already cover the escalation; yemen_red_sea holds 90/imminent without double-counting.

latest_news.title: Zelenskiy alleges approval for up to 50,000 North Korean troops in Russia
latest_news.summary: Reuters reports Zelenskiy said 30,000–50,000 North Korean troops had been approved for deployment and sought South Korean air-defence aid. He did not disclose the basis; no independent confirmation of the claimed deployment was reported. No signal change.

latest_news.headline: Overnight Russia-Ukraine strikes kill seven and wound many on both sides
latest_news.text: Associated Press reports reciprocal overnight strikes killed seven civilians across Ukraine and Russia. Russian missiles hit residential buildings in Kharkiv, killing two and injuring 13, while dozens of missiles and drones struck Odesa and wounded at least eight; Russian authorities reported additional deaths from Ukrainian attacks. The war tracker remains at its 99 ceiling and no separate canonical signal changes.

latest_news.headline: Taiwan to propose 16% rise in 2027 defence spending
latest_news.text: Reuters, citing Taiwan’s Central News Agency, reports the cabinet will propose defence spending above T$1.1 trillion for 2027, more than 3% of GDP and 16% above the prior year. This is a material self-defence and allied-burden posture update, but it is a future budget proposal rather than a fresh PRC military_buildup event; China remains 24 raw / 29 coupled.

latest_news.headline: U.S. rejects Chinese enforcement of Scarborough Reef nature reserve
latest_news.text: The U.S. State Department said China is using environmental and legal pretexts backed by coercion to deny Filipino fishermen access at Scarborough Reef and reiterated support for treaty ally the Philippines. The statement raises allied diplomatic pressure but includes no new deployment, collision or armed exchange; no canonical signal or score changes.

latest_news.headline: Jizan Aramco facility fire extinguished; Houthis claim refinery strike
latest_news.text: Reuters reports Saudi Aramco industrial crews extinguished an early-Sunday fire at a Jizan refinery facility with no injuries. The Houthis separately claimed they struck the refinery with a missile; Saudi Arabia's Energy Ministry did not state the cause. Canonical infrastructure_strike is activated with attribution uncertainty explicit.

latest_news.headline: Al-Nujaba rejects Saudi diplomacy and vows missile retaliation
latest_news.text: Harakat Hezbollah al-Nujaba chief Akram al-Kaabi said diplomacy with Saudi Arabia was futile and that missiles must be answered with missiles. The statement cuts against the broader Islamic Resistance in Iraq postponement without proving an attack is imminent; diplomacy_active remains, while canonical diplomacy_refused is activated.

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: The official IAEA Iran Board-report index still shows GOV/2026/33 dated 4 Jun as the newest safeguards report. No fresh evidence of 90% enrichment, a nuclear test, Fordow activation or restored/denied access threshold surfaced; raw/coupled risk holds 56/64

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: The 06Z full review found fresh SBS-indexed corroboration of the already logged Reuters/Dawn picture: Iran-Oman route talks remain close, but normal Hormuz traffic is still conditional on broader U.S. concessions and no normalization was verified. Existing canonical signals diplomacy_active, hormuz_controlled_not_closed and oil_infrastructure_threat remain active. Risk stays at the 95 raw / 100 coupled ceiling

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reported Aug. 7 agreement on a shortlist of possible troop contributors for a future Hezbollah-disarmament verification force, renewing diplomacy_active after its older event instance reached TTL. Continuing truce violations keep ceasefire_violation active. Raw/coupled risk holds 95/100

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP reports the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement requires a member to request help; assistance could range from intelligence and logistics to military-unit deployment depending on the threat. Türkiye says it targets no third country, preserves existing alliances and may later include Egypt. No public nuclear-sharing provision or configured nuclear_rhetoric_official, diplomacy_active or missile_range_test threshold is met; risk holds 5/deterrent

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The extended review found two Indian soldiers injured by a landmine in Poonch near the Line of Control on Aug. 6, but no independently verified cross-border clash or force deployment. The event does not meet the canonical military_buildup threshold; risk holds 15/ELEVATED

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h indexes produced humanitarian/context reporting but no independently corroborated new cross-border strike, clash or force buildup. Risk holds 46/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP reports sustained reciprocal strikes on Aug. 9, including residential hits in Kharkiv and Odesa. Reuters reports President Zelenskiy said 30,000–50,000 North Korean troops had been approved for deployment in Russia and asked South Korea for air-defence support, but he did not disclose his evidence and no independent deployment confirmation was reported. The tracker is already at the 99/IMMINENT ceiling; no new canonical signal is applied

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP and Reuters report Syria and Russia agreed to reorganize Moscow's Tartous and Hmeimim presence: Syria will take civil control of Hmeimim airport and Tartous's commercial berth, while military facilities become joint training centers during a three-month transition. Russia had not immediately commented. This narrows Russia's unilateral Mediterranean operating posture but activates neither configured russia signal; raw/coupled risk holds 70/80

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Taiwan’s cabinet will propose a 16% annual rise in 2027 defence spending to above T$1.1 trillion, Reuters reports. The future budget is a material self-defence posture update but not a fresh PRC military_buildup event; raw/coupled risk holds 24/29

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters, AP and Yonhap confirm North Korea launched at least one short-range ballistic missile from Wonsan toward the sea east of the Korean Peninsula on Aug. 6, its first ballistic launch since late June and shortly before expected U.S.-ROK exercises. The canonical missile_range_test signal activates; raw risk rises 18→24 (ELEVATED). No nuclear test, ICBM launch, impact in Japan or strike on another state was reported

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: An Aug. 7 alliance of African rights groups called for an independent investigation into older allegations that Sudan's army used chemical weapons. The appeal and July sanctions are serious accountability context, but no fresh chemical attack, deployment or other configured event was independently verified in this scan. Risk holds 94/imminent with no new canonical signal

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters and AP report that Prime Minister Netanyahu explicitly rejected the U.S. Board of Peace 15-point Gaza plan on Aug. 9 and said the IDF would not withdraw until Hamas is fully disarmed; Hamas says it remains committed to the roadmap. This activates canonical diplomacy_refused. The conditional stabilization-force planning still supports diplomacy_active, so both signals remain active. At the near-certain ceiling, raw/coupled risk rises 98→99 and remains IMMINENT

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: The UN Security Council heard fresh warnings of institutional collapse, famine risk in four counties, deadly cholera and attacks on aid workers as the political settlement frays. This materially worsens humanitarian and political context but does not independently verify a new configured military_buildup, ceasefire_violation or diplomacy_refused event. Risk holds 19/elevated

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: The Aug. 7 Congo-AFC/M23 prisoner transfer remains a concrete implementation step and canonical diplomacy_active remains active after deploy reconciliation. Raw/coupled risk holds 53/imminent amid unresolved fighting, territorial control and Rwanda-support allegations

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP reports Houthi missiles, drones and an explosive boat struck the government-held Red Sea port of Mokha on Aug. 9, killing at least seven people, injuring 15 civilians, and damaging port buildings, piers, commercial goods and food supplies. The Houthis claimed military forces and warehouses as targets. This follows the claimed drone attack on Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery, where Saudi authorities confirmed an extinguished fire but did not attribute its cause. Existing canonical ceasefire_violation and infrastructure_strike already capture these events; no duplicate signal or probability inflation is applied. Risk holds 90/IMMINENT and rising

dashboard_trackers.name: MALI SAHEL
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h review found no distinct new attack, deployment or foreign-support delivery beyond older context. The prior foreign-support indicator aged out under the configured 168-hour rule; risk holds 43/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH CHINA SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: The U.S. rejected Chinese enforcement of the Scarborough Reef nature reserve and reiterated support for the Philippines. This is allied diplomatic pressure, not a new deployment, collision or armed exchange; risk holds 35/critical with no canonical signal change

dashboard_trackers.name: SOMALIA GULF OF ADEN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh UKMTO/JMIC piracy incident was verified. Search results for a Sri Lankan trawler described a January 2024 event, and the AP fuel-tanker item was from April 2026; both were excluded as stale. Risk holds 28/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTHERN THAILAND
dashboard_trackers.notes: A local report says security forces conducted an operation against suspects linked to the 22 Jul Narathiwat checkpoint attack. Without independent corroboration or evidence of a broader force buildup, no signal was activated; risk holds 30/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: KUWAIT IRAQ BORDER
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h RSS returned no fresh Kuwait-Iraq border-drone incident. Earlier hostile-drone spillover remains the baseline context; no configured signal changed and risk holds 30/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAQ INTERNAL CONFLICT
dashboard_trackers.notes: Harakat Hezbollah al-Nujaba leader Akram al-Kaabi explicitly rejected diplomacy with Saudi Arabia and vowed a military response to the July U.S.-Saudi strikes, according to his Saturday statement carried by ANI/The Tribune. The wider Islamic Resistance in Iraq postponement and Iraq-Saudi engagement keep canonical diplomacy_active in place, but the factional rejection activates diplomacy_refused alongside military_buildup. Raw/coupled risk reverses 42→45, remains CRITICAL, and the umbrella pause is now visibly fragile

dashboard_trackers.name: KENYA SOMALIA BORDER
dashboard_trackers.notes: Multiple Kenyan outlets now corroborate the Mandera IED cluster: six people were wounded near Elwak, a suspected device detonated while carried in Mandera East, and suspected al-Shabaab fighters fired an RPG and small arms at the Fino police camp before retreating. The cluster sharpens the watch but does not meet the configured infrastructure_strike or military_buildup thresholds; risk holds 25/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: EGYPT MEDITERRANEAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Regional reporting says operations resumed at Damietta after the earlier drone attack. No fresh Mediterranean strike was verified and no canonical de-escalatory signal applies; risk holds 20/elevated

dashboard_trackers.name: SPAIN MOROCCO CEUTA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Middle East Eye reported the Ceuta migrant-disaster death toll had risen to 141, while most entrants had already returned to Morocco. The humanitarian toll rose, but no new military buildup or Spain-Morocco interstate kinetic threshold emerged; risk holds 22/elevated

dashboard_trackers.name: ETHIOPIA TIGRAY
dashboard_trackers.notes: Critical Threats Project assessed the Aug. 1 western-Tigray fighting as major but limited and found no later clash in the review window. ENDF reinforcement/checkpoint activity and separate ENDF/TPLF mobilization near Alamata remain the live configured indicator. The older clash and framework-breakdown indicators have decayed; risk holds 32/critical

allied_positions.middle_east_allies: The Saudi-Türkiye-Pakistan pact remains the main allied restructuring. Türkiye says it targets no third country; Egypt may join later. Saudi Arabia confirmed the Jizan fire but not Houthi causation, and no Saudi counterstrike was verified.
allied_positions.un_eu: UN/EU condemnations of Houthi attacks remain current. No fresh multinational maritime deployment was announced.
allied_positions.ukraine_partners: Zelenskiy requested South Korean air-defence support while alleging approval for 30,000–50,000 North Korean troops in Russia; the projected troop figure lacks disclosed evidence and independent confirmation.
allied_positions.israel_lebanon: U.S.-mediated talks and possible Hezbollah-disarmament verification planning continue, but Israeli incursions/strikes and Lebanese-army injuries keep implementation risk high.
allied_positions.iaea: The IAEA Iran Board index still lists GOV/2026/33 (4 June) as the newest safeguards report. No fresh access restoration, verified 90% enrichment, weaponization evidence, material-accounting change or nuclear test was found.
allied_positions.asia_pacific: Taiwan is preparing a 16% increase in proposed 2027 defence spending; Washington rejected China's Scarborough reserve enforcement. No new force deployment was reported.
allied_positions.russia_mediterranean: Syria says it will take civil control of Hmeimim airport and Tartous's commercial berth while military facilities become joint training centers over a three-month transition. Russia had not immediately commented.
